row: 🎧🎙A podcast for Chiropractors with hosts Drs. Rich & Haley Day, co-authors of the ChiroPlanner, a planner for Chiropractic students and new Chiropractors, and co-creators of The Foundation, an online library of resources for Chiropractic practice start-up. Learn about current trends in Chiropractic business and marketing from successful Chiropractors and businesses that serve Chiropractors. We also have guests from other industries to discuss the trends in social media, marketing, mindset, systems, and sales. For downloadable resources and more, visit our website(lifestylepracticebuilders.com) or find us on Facebook or Instagram(@lifestylepractice)!
